configSteps.title: Your business up and running in 4 steps
configSteps.subtitle: Forget about eternal configurations. Gestly guides you step by step.

1.title: Configure your Business
1.desc: Create multiple branches, register employees with specific roles and assign permissions by location.

2.title: Define your Stock
2.desc: Choose simple control (Yes/No) or complex stock with exact quantities and independent inventory per branch.

3.title: Quick Load
3.desc: Select your category and use smart templates. Activate the products you sell in each branch and define your initial stock.

4.title: Start Selling!
4.desc: All set. Register sales, manage tabs and control your cash register from any device.

createProduct.title: How to create a product
steps: Open the app and go to the 'Catalog' section.
Tap the '+' button in the bottom corner.
Enter the name, price, and barcode.

makeSale.title: Register a sale
steps: Scan the product or search for it manually.
Choose the payment method and confirm.

addStock.title: Add stock
steps: Search for the product to update.

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: From a school project to revolutionizing commerce.

story.title: The Origin
story.description: Gestly was born as a humble school project with a clear vision: to simplify the lives of merchants. What started in a classroom now seeks to expand throughout Argentina and soon to the world.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We want anyone, regardless of the size of their business, to access professional tools. It is time to leave pen and paper behind.
